payload.reason: The evidence provides specific improvement margins for the ZAT model compared to other models, particularly in terms of absolute F1-score.

claims.text: The ZAT model shows an improvement of 7.24% in absolute F1-score when training with 2000 instances.
ZAT achieves an improvement of 14.67% in absolute F1-score over CRF when training with 500 instances.
ZAT has a statistically significant mean improvement of 4.04 points over LSTM-BoE with training size 500.
ZAT shows an average improvement of 5.07 over CT when no target domain data is available.
